data.title: Make a room navigable for an NPC
data.summary: An 8 by 6 m room, two obstacles and a 0.5 m agent radius. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Godot navigation supports path queries over navigation-mesh regions.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender → Godot or Unity environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: An 8 by 6 m room, two obstacles and a 0.5 m agent radius.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent navmesh room workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: An 8 by 6 m room, two obstacles and a 0.5 m agent radius. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Import the room with simple static collision and mark the intended floor region
Bake a navigation region using the configured agent radius and height
Request paths to five marked targets and inspect doorways and obstacle clearance

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned make a room navigable for an npc candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: All reachable targets return paths within the floor region
A sealed target is reported unreachable rather than teleported to
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: A navigation mesh is separate from collision and cannot prove animation quality.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Bake with the same agent dimensions used at runtime.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me make a room navigable for an npc in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: An 8 by 6 m room, two obstacles and a 0.5 m agent radius. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: All reachable targets return paths within the floor region; A sealed target is reported unreachable rather than teleported to. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
